definitions.gloss: faculty of agriculture; school of agriculture
definitions.explanation: The division of a university that teaches and researches agriculture, including crop science, animal science, forestry, and food science.

examples.japanese: {農学部|のうがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りたい→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I want to enter the faculty of agriculture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{農学部|のうがくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧だ。
examples.english: My older brother is a student in the faculty of agriculture.

examples.japanese: {農学部|のうがくぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
